amb_party: rooftop party at night, distant city traffic, muffled bass music from a speaker, faint crowd chatter
toast: glass bottles and plastic cups clinking in a toast, people cheering
blackout: power outage, electric hum powering down, speaker music abruptly cutting off with a thunk, then silence
rumble: deep low frequency ground tremor rumble, glasses rattling, building shaking
boom_far: distant massive explosion with delayed rolling boom echoing over a city at night
roar: giant monster roar, extremely deep distorted, echoing across a city, close then far
alarms: many car alarms and distant sirens across a city at night, faint screams far away
collapse: huge building collapsing, concrete debris crumbling, rumbling wall of dust
handling: handheld camcorder microphone handling noise, rustling fabric
rec_beep: camera record start beep and click
hit: cinematic sub bass impact hit, deep boom with long tail
riser: cinematic tension riser building up, dark
glitch: digital video tape glitch static burst
wind: strong night wind on a rooftop
fire: distant fire crackling and burning, low rumble
